scores.label: A
scores.note: Only option 1 'questioning' fits. Options 2-10 are adjectives ('hesitant', 'unsure', 'uncertain', 'wary', 'skeptical', 'insecure', 'self-doubtful', 'cynical', 'distrustful'), so they are ungrammatical before 'himself'. 'cynical' and 'wary' are also the wrong sense.

scores.label: B
scores.note: Options 1 'questioning' and 3 'second-guessing' are strong. Options 2 'hesitating', 4 'wondering', 5 'vacillating' and 7 'struggling' are intransitive, so they are ungrammatical before 'himself'. Option 6 'worrying himself' has a different meaning. Option 10 'uncertain' is an adjective and is ungrammatical in place. Options 8 and 9 failed as duplicates.
